next.reason: §1985:VII.4.4.2 is 'READ file-name-1 [NEXT] RECORD [INTO identifier-1] [AT END ...] [NOT AT END ...] [END-READ]', AT END before NOT AT END. §2023:14.9.30.2 'Format 1 (sequential)' accepts every such READ with the same meaning, the omitted NEXT given by §2023:14.9.30.3 SR8 ('If neither the NEXT phrase nor the PREVIOUS phrase is specified and ACCESS MODE SEQUENTIAL is specified ... the NEXT phrase is implied'); but it adds PREVIOUS, ADVANCING ON LOCK, IGNORING LOCK, the retry-phrase and WITH [NO] LOCK, and puts AT END and NOT AT END in choice-indicator brackets, so either order is accepted. Programs the 1985 format refuses are accepted, no refusal made an exception condition: CHANGED.
